entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: Hello, this is Hanasaki from[n]the flower shop, Rafflesia.

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: Sorry to bug you, but[n]could you come into[n]work today?

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: There's a storewide discount[n]today, and I don't know if[n]I can handle the rush alone.

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: I'll make sure you get paid[n]a little extra for it!

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: Let me know if you[n]can come by, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you'd be putting together bouquets?[n]Sounds like a good chance to work on[n]your [stIcon 4][clr 26][stLabel 4][clr 27].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you're not doing anything else, you[n]could go help her out. Up to you.
